# Three.js vendor copy

`three.module.js` and its relative import `three.core.js` are the ES module
build of Three.js 0.186.1, downloaded from
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.1/build/` on 2026-10-27.
SHA-256 of `three.module.js`: `9052042d676cb0fdc1ddfefe193053f34b7ac0513a616fdac4535d49987812ea`.
SHA-256 of `three.core.js`: `9edde002b066a9a05676a6127f67735b62baf399bdea529f2f7e31657da769e6`.
The accompanying `LICENSE` was downloaded from the same package version.
The local copy makes the interactive pages independent of a CDN at lesson time.
